name: Box transform and handle hit
description: Transform/BoxMath.swift: LayerTransform (scale, degrees, move) and BoxMath (resize by an EditorHandle with Shift aspect and Option centre, at least 1 and never flipping; several items scaled as one box; 15 degree rotate snap; the handle rects). Transform/HandleHit.swift: HandleHit (the handle under a point, Chebyshev with corners winning ties; a screen tolerance divided by zoom). Stubs from EK-3; bodies EK-20. Transform/TransformRules.swift: FlipDirection, BoxAnchor (nine points), TransformBox (an unturned box, its clockwise turn and its mirrors) and TransformRules (normalize, rotate, flip, scale about an anchor, corners, bounds, local and the matrix, the Canvas Size anchored origin). Transform/TransformCommands.swift: the TransformTarget protocol, TransformIntent and TransformCommands' six transform.* specs (read, set, rotate, scale, flip, reset). Stubs from transform-tools TT-1; bodies TT-5 and TT-6.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
